## Purpose

Gemma 2/3/4 use `gelu_pytorch_tanh` in their gated MLPs. With NVFP4 checkpoints the input quantization of `down_proj` is always a custom op (`scaled_fp4_quant`), so Inductor cannot fuse it with the activation: every layer runs `gelu_tanh_and_mul` (or the Inductor-generated gelu·mul kernel) and then `cvt_fp16_to_fp4`, writing and re-reading a bf16 activation of `intermediate_size` elements per token. All existing fused activation+quant kernels in vLLM are SiLU-only (`silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant`, `silu_and_mul_quant`, ...).

This PR:

- generalizes `silu_mul_cvt_fp16_to_fp4` into `act_mul_cvt_fp16_to_fp4<Type, ActMul>` and adds `gelu_tanh_and_mul_nvfp4_quant` (same launch, same swizzled block-scale layout; `compute_silu_mul` keeps its arithmetic);
- registers `(GeluAndMul, kNvfp4Dynamic)` in the manual act+quant fusion registry (`fused_act_quant.py`, follow-up to #51415 / tracker #43501), with a predicate that only accepts `approximate="tanh"` and `d % 16 == 0`;
- wires `maybe_fused_act_quant` into `Gemma2MLP`, `Gemma3MLP`, `Gemma4MLP` (one line each, like `llama.py`);
- launches the fused kernel with programmatic dependent launch (PDL), the same protocol `cvt_fp16_to_fp4` already uses (`cudaGridDependencySynchronize()` + `cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion()` at kernel start, `cudaLaunchKernelEx` with `ProgrammaticStreamSerialization`). **This also changes the launch of the existing `silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant`**, which shares the template; its outputs are bit-identical (see below), but I have not measured a SiLU model end to end. Happy to split this into its own PR if preferred;
- adds the defunctionalization branch for the new op, tests, a benchmark and a docs line.

Numerics: the fused kernel evaluates `gelu(gate) * up` in fp32 and rounds once to the input dtype before quantizing, like `compute_silu_mul` and like the default Inductor path. The CUDA op `gelu_tanh_and_mul` rounds the activation to bf16 before the multiply, so the two are not bit-identical (~0.7 % of FP4 codes differ at 4096×43008); against an fp32 single-rounding reference the fused kernel produced 0 differing FP4 codes on every shape tested (up to 4096×43008). The two large test shapes therefore run only in the single-rounding test: the existing `assert_close` test compares against a reference that rounds twice, and at ~1e5 elements a one-code FP4 flip exceeds its tolerance for the upstream SiLU kernel as well.

Not a duplicate: #51415 (merged) added the SiLU manual fusion; #53874 (ROCm GeGLU+FP8 group quant, closed by the author after "TTFT worse") is a different quant path, and its failure mode (the GEMM after the fused kernel slowing down) is measured below; #59384 (ReLU2+NVFP4, open) covers a different activation and model but edits the same registry file, so one of the two will need a trivial rebase. No open PR touches GELU + NVFP4.

### Scope / limitations

- Dense MLPs only. `nvidia/Gemma-4-26B-A4B-NVFP4` keeps its dense MLPs in bf16, so it does not exercise this path; MoE experts already fuse the activation inside the FlashInfer kernels. Gemma 2/3 are wired but not measured (no official NVFP4 checkpoints).
- Measured on RTX 5090 (SM120) only; the kernel is built for `sm_100a` and `sm_120a` like the SiLU one. Numbers on B200 / RTX PRO 6000 welcome.
- `GeluAndMul(approximate="none")` keeps the unfused path (test included).

## Test Plan

```bash
pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_silu_mul_nvfp4_quant.py             # 40 passed (RTX 5090, sm_120)
pytest tests/compile/passes/test_silu_mul_quant_manual_fusion.py           # 55 passed
pytest tests/kernels/test_fused_quant_activation.py                         # 99 passed
pytest tests/fusion/test_quant_activation_contract.py                       # 4 passed
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck  ... (fused gelu kernel, 4 shapes up to 130×43008)  # 0 errors
compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck ... (fused gelu kernel, 4 shapes up to 130×43008)  # 0 hazards
python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_act_mul_nvfp4_quant.py --check          # 8/8 OK
pre-commit run --files <changed files>   # all hooks pass (ruff, ruff format, typos, clang-format, mypy 3.10, SPDX, markdownlint, ...)
```

The standalone `silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant` built from this branch is bit-identical to the wheel's kernel on 4 shapes (up to 4096×43008) and within 0.3 % of its time, with and without the PDL change.

## Test Result

### Kernel: gated activation + NVFP4 quant, input `[M, 2N]` bf16 → `[M, N]` NVFP4 (us, `do_bench_cudagraph`, no L2 flush; RTX 5090, torch 2.13.0+cu130, commit bcdacfc)

N = 21504 (Gemma-4-31B `down_proj` input):

| M | CUDA op + quant | Inductor + quant | fused | fused / Inductor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.24 | 2.25 | 1.84 | 0.82 |
| 16 | 4.64 | 2.68 | 1.92 | 0.72 |
| 128 | 5.66 | 5.80 | 3.91 | 0.67 |
| 1024 | 76.8 | 75.6 | 26.1 | 0.35 * |
| 4096 | 468.6 | 467.0 | 245.9 | 0.53 |
| 8192 | 954.8 | 952.2 | 509.8 | 0.54 |

N = 15360 (Gemma-4-12B):

| M | CUDA op + quant | Inductor + quant | fused | fused / Inductor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.25 | 1.93 | 1.82 | 0.94 |
| 16 | 3.83 | 2.58 | 1.90 | 0.74 |
| 128 | 4.42 | 4.46 | 3.04 | 0.68 |
| 1024 | 28.3 | 28.1 | 15.0 | 0.53 |
| 4096 | 320.0 | 318.8 | 167.3 | 0.52 |
| 8192 | 681.4 | 680.1 | 362.1 | 0.53 |

| M | act+quant (us) | down GEMM Δ (in graph) | block Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.3 → 1.9 | −0.3 % | +0.0 % |
| 16 | 2.6 → 2.0 | +0.5 % | −0.0 % |
| 64 | 3.7 → 2.1 | +1.3 % | −1.8 % |
| 128 | 5.2 → 3.1 | +0.8 % | −3.0 % |
| 256 | 8.6 → 5.3 | +0.9 % | −1.6 % |
| 512 | 16.2 → 8.9 | +0.3 % | −2.9 % |
| 1024 | 31.5 → 18.6 | +0.2 % (103.0 → 103.2) | −4.5 % (319.5 → 305.2) |
| 4096 | 306.1 → 170.1 | +4.5 % (310.1 → 324.1) | −9.0 % (1348.6 → 1226.8) |
| 8192 | 680.7 → 368.5 | +2.1 % | −9.2 % |

Gemma-4-31B shape (5376 → 43008 → act → 21504 → 5376), same method, measured earlier on a different RTX 5090 (575 W limit): block −8.9..−10.8 % at M=4096, −7.5..−8.5 % at M=8192, −3.2..−4.0 % at M=1024, within ±2 % at M ≤ 128; the down GEMM stays within ±3 % except at M=128 with L2 flushed (+5 % in eager per-kernel timing while the block time is unchanged).

Note on the down GEMM: at M=4096 (12B shape) the GEMM after the fused kernel is ~4.5 % slower (both eager and in-graph timing). The block still wins by 9 % because the activation write+read is gone; reported here so the #53874 failure mode is visible. In the full model (below) the down GEMM is within +1 %.

### End to end (`vllm bench latency`, ABBA interleaved, RTX 5090 at 500 W, `RedHatAI/gemma-4-12B-it-NVFP4`, attention TRITON_ATTN, `FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel`)

| Workload | base (ms, 4 runs) | fused (ms, 4 runs) | Δ | A/A spread |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| prefill 4096 tokens, batch 1 (10 iters/run, ABBA ×2; one 4096-token chunk, `max_num_batched_tokens=8192`) | 177.72 (177.55–177.89) | **172.09 (172.01–172.31)** | **−5.6 ms, −3.2 %** (pairs −3.30/−3.09/−3.15/−3.12 %) | 0.20 % |
| decode 64 in / 512 out, batch 1 (5 iters/run, ABBA ×2) | 3578.1 (3575.8–3579.1) | **3527.0 (3525.7–3527.7)** | **−51 ms, −1.4 %** (−100 us per step; pairs −1.35/−1.43/−1.49/−1.44 %) | 0.09 % |
| decode 64 in / 512 out, batch 16 (kernel without PDL, see below) | 4318.6 (4316.0–4321.2) | 4314.8 (4311.8–4317.3) | −0.09 % (pairs −0.06/−0.13/−0.20/+0.03 %) | 0.12 % → noise |

| group | base (ms) | fused (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| Inductor gelu·mul (`triton_poi_fused_gelu_mul_…`, 48×) | 10.52 | 0 |
| `cvt_fp16_to_fp4` (192× → 144×) | 5.79 | 1.45 |
| `act_mul_cvt_fp16_to_fp4<GeluTanhMul>` (48×) | 0 | 8.33 |
| FP4 GEMMs (192×) | 63.96 | 64.56 (+0.9 %); down GEMM median 324.3 → 327.2 us |
| attention (48×) | 73.39 | 73.28 |
| all kernels | 162.86 | 156.78 (−3.7 %) |

The fusion fires in 48/48 layers (48 fused kernels, 48 fewer quant kernels, the Inductor gelu·mul kernel gone).

| | base | base again (A/A) | fused |
|---|---|---|---|
| accuracy, 1319 questions | 93.56 % | 93.25 % | 93.18 % |
| accuracy, first 500 | 94.20 % | 94.40 % | 93.60 % |
| same final answer as base (1319) | – | 95.7 % | 95.3 % |
| identical generated text vs base (1319, batched) | – | 35.9 % | 24.3 % |
| identical generated text vs base (first 200, `max_num_seqs=1`, greedy) | – | **200/200** | **200/200** (accuracy 96.0 % both) |

Batched greedy decoding in vLLM is not batch-invariant (the base model against itself reproduces only 36 % of the texts at the default batch size), so text identity is measured at batch size 1, where decoding is deterministic (base vs base: 200/200): on these 200 questions the fused path reproduces the base model's generations token for token.

## AI assistance

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to write the kernel scaffold, tests, benchmark and measurement scripts, to drive the measurement sessions and to draft this description. I reviewed every changed line and can explain the change end to end; all numbers come from runs on hardware I rented, and the raw logs are available on request.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Fused gated activation + NVFP4 quantization vs the two-kernel path.
+
+For one activation and (M, N), input [M, 2N] -> NVFP4 [M, N] + block scales:
+  cuda_act_quant     torch.ops._C.<act>_and_mul, then scaled_fp4_quant
+  inductor_act_quant torch.compile(forward_native), then scaled_fp4_quant
+                     (what vLLM runs by default: custom ops off, FP4 quant
+                     is always a custom op)
+  fused              torch.ops._C.<act>_and_mul_nvfp4_quant
+
+    python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_act_mul_nvfp4_quant.py \
+        --activation gelu_tanh --n 21504 2112
+    python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_act_mul_nvfp4_quant.py --check
+"""
+
+import argparse
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.benchmarks.lib.utils import default_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.activation import GeluAndMul, SiluAndMul
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.nvfp4_emulation_utils import (
+    dequantize_to_dtype,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.scalar_type import scalar_types
+from vllm.triton_utils import triton
+
+if not current_platform.has_device_capability(100):
+    raise RuntimeError("NVFP4 requires compute capability of 10.0 (Blackwell)")
+
+# forward_native is compiled once per (M, N); lift the per-function limit.
+torch._dynamo.config.recompile_limit = 8888
+
+FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX = scalar_types.float4_e2m1f.max()
+FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX = torch.finfo(torch.float8_e4m3fn).max
+
+# activation -> (layer factory, unfused CUDA op, fused CUDA op)
+ACTIVATIONS = {
+    "silu": (SiluAndMul, "silu_and_mul", "silu_and_mul_nvfp4_quant"),
+    "gelu_tanh": (
+        lambda: GeluAndMul(approximate="tanh"),
+        "gelu_tanh_and_mul",
+        "gelu_tanh_and_mul_nvfp4_quant",
+    ),
+}
+PROVIDERS = ["cuda_act_quant", "inductor_act_quant", "fused"]
+M_VALS = [1, 16, 128, 1024, 4096, 8192]
+
+
+def global_scale(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    amax = torch.abs(t).max().to(torch.float32)
+    return FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX * FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX / amax
+
+
+def make_case(activation: str, M: int, N: int, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    """Return ({provider: fn}, global_scale, x) for one input x of [M, 2N]."""
+    make_layer, act_name, fused_name = ACTIVATIONS[activation]
+    layer = make_layer()
+    x = torch.randn((M, 2 * N), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    gs = global_scale(layer.forward_native(x))
+    act_op = getattr(torch.ops._C, act_name)
+    fused_op = getattr(torch.ops._C, fused_name)
+    act_buf = torch.empty((M, N), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    out, sf = ops.scaled_fp4_quant(act_buf, gs)
+    native = torch.compile(layer.forward_native, dynamic=False)
+
+    def cuda_act_quant():
+        act_op(act_buf, x)
+        return ops.scaled_fp4_quant(act_buf, gs)
+
+    def inductor_act_quant():
+        return ops.scaled_fp4_quant(native(x), gs)
+
+    def fused():
+        fused_op(out, sf, x, gs)
+        return out, sf
+
+    fns = {
+        "cuda_act_quant": cuda_act_quant,
+        "inductor_act_quant": inductor_act_quant,
+        "fused": fused,
+    }
+    return fns, gs, x
+
+
+@triton.testing.perf_report(
+    triton.testing.Benchmark(
+        x_names=["M"],
+        x_vals=M_VALS,
+        x_log=False,
+        line_arg="provider",
+        line_vals=PROVIDERS,
+        line_names=PROVIDERS,
+        ylabel="us (lower is better)",
+        plot_name="act_mul + NVFP4 quant latency (us)",
+        args={},
+    )
+)
+def benchmark(M, provider, activation, N):
+    fns, _, _ = make_case(activation, M, N)
+    ms, min_ms, max_ms = triton.testing.do_bench_cudagraph(
+        fns[provider], quantiles=[0.5, 0.2, 0.8]
+    )
+    return ms * 1000, max_ms * 1000, min_ms * 1000
+
+
+def check(activation: str) -> None:
+    """Fraction of FP4 codes that differ from an fp32 single-rounding reference
+    (the fused kernels round once, like the Inductor path; gelu_tanh must stay
+    <= 0.1%, silu uses fast-math intrinsics and is only reported), plus the
+    largest dequantized difference from cuda_act_quant as information: that
+    path rounds twice, so a rare one-code FP4 step at large magnitude is
+    expected and is not asserted on."""
+    for M, N in [(1, 128), (7, 2112), (5, 21504), (256, 4096)]:
+        fns, gs, x = make_case(activation, M, N)
+        ref_q, ref_s = fns["cuda_act_quant"]()
+        out_q, out_s = fns["fused"]()
+        # The kernels fold gs into the block scales; dequantize with 1/gs.
+        ref = dequantize_to_dtype(ref_q, ref_s, 1.0 / gs, torch.bfloat16)
+        out = dequantize_to_dtype(out_q, out_s, 1.0 / gs, torch.bfloat16)
+        max_abs = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs().max().item()
+        gate, up = x[:, :N].float(), x[:, N:].float()
+        act = (
+            F.gelu(gate, approximate="tanh")
+            if activation == "gelu_tanh"
+            else F.silu(gate)
+        )
+        ref32_q, _ = ops.scaled_fp4_quant((act * up).to(torch.bfloat16), gs)
+        mismatch = (out_q != ref32_q).float().mean().item()
+        if activation == "gelu_tanh":
+            assert mismatch <= 1e-3, f"{activation} M={M} N={N}: {mismatch:.2e}"
+        print(
+            f"{activation} M={M} N={N}: OK (packed FP4 bytes differing from the "
+            f"fp32 single-rounding reference: {mismatch:.2e}; max |dequant - "
+            f"cuda_act_quant| {max_abs:.3f})"
+        )
+
+
+@default_vllm_config()
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Fused activation + NVFP4 quantization benchmark"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--activation",
+        nargs="+",
+        choices=list(ACTIVATIONS),
+        default=["gelu_tanh", "silu"],
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--n", nargs="+", type=int, default=[21504, 2112])
+    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--save-path", type=str, default=None)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if args.check:
+        for activation in args.activation:
+            check(activation)
+        return
+
+    for activation in args.activation:
+        for N in args.n:
+            print(f"\n{activation}, N={N} (input [M, {2 * N}] -> [M, {N}] NVFP4)")
+            benchmark.run(
+                print_data=True, save_path=args.save_path, activation=activation, N=N
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
